subject: Post-demo: Procurement gatekeeper orchestration & MAP next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Eliza Porter <eliza.porter@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Procurement gatekeeper orchestration & MAP next steps

Hi Eliza —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with procurement:

1) Procurement path options we heard from your team:
   - PO via finance (preferred for enterprise purchases)
   - Corporate card for initial POC (smaller dollar)
   - AWS Marketplace as a long-term option (EdgeHealth uses AWS in prod)

2) Gatekeeper sequence (what you mentioned): Legal review -> Security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) -> Finance approval -> PO issuance

3) Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) milestones:
   - Legal review kickoff (EdgeHealth legal): target 2027-03-21
   - Security questionnaire completion + evidence handoff (Redwood provides SOC2): target 2027-03-24
   - Finance decision (PO vs card): target 2027-03-26
   - PO issuance or card payment: target 2027-04-01

Could you confirm the internal owners for legal, security, and finance so we can loop them in and drop a MAP doc? If you want, Monica on our team can send the SOC2 package and a draft MAP spreadsheet.

Attaching a lightweight MAP template and SOC2 stub (sending full SOC2 on request).

Thanks — I’ll hold a slot next Tue/Thu for a short procurement sync.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: [MAP_EdgeHealth_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), EdgeHealth_SOC2_v3.pdf (PDF stub)]

From: Eliza Porter <eliza.porter@edgehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Darren Lee <darren.lee@edgehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Procurement gatekeeper orchestration & MAP next steps

Thanks, Tessa — good summary and appreciated. Quick answers:

- Legal owner: I will own coordination but legal reviewer is Marie Ortega (marie.ortega@edgehealth.com).
- Security owner: Darren Lee (cc'd) will lead the SOC2 checklist and ask for evidence.
- Finance owner: Darren will also pull in FinanceOps for PO processing; if quick POC desired we may use a corporate card.

The dates you proposed look reasonable. Please have Monica share the SOC2 pack and MAP; Darren will review the security questionnaire by 3/24.

Also, we are interested in marketplace options but that will be a separate procurement lane (longer timeline).

Eliza
Head of Product | EdgeHealth

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Monica. I pulled the MAP and SOC2 summary into our tracking board. A few notes from Finance/Security POV:

- Security: SOC2 summary looks fine; we will request a short runbook showing data separation and retention (please include retention policy reference).
- Finance: we need a commercial quote that explicitly calls out seat vs token pricing, monthly commit (if any), and cancellation terms. That will speed PO approval.

Can you send a commercial quote PDF and the retention/runbook pieces by EOD 2027-03-17? If we get those, we expect finance decision by 2027-03-26.

— Darren
Procurement & Finance Ops | EdgeHealth
